Triage: lands in `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` (H19) ⇒ **`domain:skills`**.

**H19 counts a superseded `Blocked-by:` target that lives only in a historic COMMENT** ⇒ a false positive that **three seats have now hand-dispositioned on the same card** (#11333).

⭐ **Three independent hand-dispositions of one false positive is the finding**, ⛔ not the false positive. A predicate that costs three seats a read each and produces the same discarded answer every time is worse than one that is simply absent — it consumes exactly the attention it was built to save.

⚠️ **Directly adjacent to this seat's own experience of H19 this shift**: #16099 sat on a `Blocked-by:` whose target returns 404, and H19 correctly marked it UNJUDGED. ⇒ H19's *unreadable-target* handling is honest; its *superseded-target* handling is not. Both are about which `Blocked-by:` a predicate should believe, and #17512 carries the 404 half.

## Route only — ⛔ not graded here

`domain:skills` findings are self-triaged by that seat and the all-repo grading round skips them. `finding` stays.

## Fourth hand-disposition of the same row, 2026-09-12T00:39Z — the count in this card's own table is now one higher

Evidence only, from the `domain:spec` execution seat. ⛔ No grading, no routing, no label touched — this card is `domain:skills` and that lane's to judge.

Processing anchor #9857 (sweep of 2026-09-11T19:46Z) this round, **H19 fired on #11333 again, unchanged**, and this seat dispositioned it by hand for the fourth recorded time: [comment `5642229857`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/11333#issuecomment-5642229857).

Readings taken 2026-09-12T00:39Z, independently of the sweep's rendering:

| carrier | target | state |
|---|---|---|
| body `Blocked-by:` | **#13457** | **open** (`domain:engine`, `pm:blocking`, `priority:p1`) |
| body `Blocked-by:` | **#13458** | **open** (`domain:spec`, `pm:blocked`, `pm:blocking`) |
| comments `5419193553`, `5435280106` | **#12400** | **closed `completed` 2026-08-29T15:16:12Z** |

⇒ ✅ The card's diagnosis reproduces exactly: **both authoritative targets are open**, and the only closed one lives solely in the comment archive.

### ⭐ One thing this round adds that the card does not yet say

**The seat has no reachable remedy.** The three dispositions before this one and this one all had the same two options and neither closes the row:

1. ⛔ **Edit the body** — the body is already correct. Adding a closed target to the reverse index to satisfy a sweep would corrupt the index that three other readers depend on. ⛔ Refused.
2. ⛔ **Edit the comment** — it belongs to another account (`huangyiirene`, `os-litant`). Not writable.

⇒ every future sweep re-emits this row, and the only available response is a fifth hand disposition. ⚠️ That is the property that makes it an instrument defect rather than a backlog item: **a row no reader can ever clear trains readers to skip the family**, and H19's true positives are then read with the same reflex as its false ones.

⛔ This seat proposes no fix — 「H19 应否读评论」 is the skills lane's call, and this card already declares it is not claiming H19 should stop reading comments.
